preconditions.description: The integer u must be non-negative and not exceed 10^18.
The integer v must be non-negative and not exceed 10^18.
The integer u must be less than or equal to v.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if (u & v) != u else True
postconditions.description: If u and v do not satisfy the condition (u & v) == u, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(arr) == n and sum(arr) == v and (u == 0 and n == 0) or (u != 0 and n > 0)
postconditions.description: The output array must have length n, sum to v, and be empty if u is 0.
All elements in the output array must be positive integers.
